purpose: Add review-only beneficiary-specific tables around the existing mp_TrackedEntity runtime identity so TACATDP beneficiaries can be modeled without creating a TACATDP-only mp_beneficiary silo.
design_decisions: Use mp_TrackedEntity as the central beneficiary identity with EntityType=beneficiary/farmer/farmer_group/amcos/saccos as controlled choices.
Keep submitted XForm payloads and submission versions as source of truth; beneficiary extension tables are current-state and analytics surfaces.
Keep finance, technology, training, and outcome facts as separate child tables so repeated and longitudinal records do not overwrite each other.
Use VocabularyTerm lookups for governed options such as technology, training topic, beneficiary category, verification status, adoption stage, and measurement method where practical.
Use Submission and Encounter lookups to preserve lineage from a beneficiary summary fact back to a collected monitoring event.
